description: 3D open-channel flow through a fixed quasi-static net panel (X 320 3, wall net, X 321/X 322; no floating body: sixdof_void with net forces). Inflow (B60=1) / outflow, free surface, laminar, 2 MPI ranks. Net forces are spread onto the CFD grid with the Peskin kernel (net_interface::dlm_cfd).
